title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #11

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is an insect? (1 mark)
   A. Butterfly
   B. Crab
   C. Snail
   D. Earthworm

2. What is a source of light? (1 mark)
   A. Something that reflects light
   B. Something that is dark
   C. Something that blocks light
   D. Something that gives out its own light

3. What can help a child with diarrhoea while waiting to see a health worker? (1 mark)
   A. Eating unwashed fruit
   B. Drinking clean water and ORS as advised
   C. Eating only sweets
   D. Drinking dirty water

4. How can a farmer keep a wheelbarrow running smoothly? (1 mark)
   A. Add sand to the wheel
   B. Oil its moving joints
   C. Leave it in the rain
   D. Use rough paint

5. Why are tyres made with rough patterns? (1 mark)
   A. To make them lighter
   B. To grip the road
   C. To reduce friction
   D. To make them shiny

6. Which force acts on a ball thrown into the air and brings it back down? (1 mark)
   A. Friction
   B. Gravity
   C. Light
   D. Sound

7. What is the source of heat that dries fish in the sun? (1 mark)
   A. A jiko
   B. A torch
   C. Electricity
   D. The sun

8. Which of these is a sign of life in plants? (1 mark)
   A. Making a loud noise
   B. Growing taller over time
   C. Walking to find water
   D. Changing into a stone

9. What is saliva? (1 mark)
   A. A germ
   B. A liquid in the mouth that wets food
   C. A type of waste
   D. A tube in the stomach

10. Which of these is a natural source of light at night? (1 mark)
   A. A street lamp
   B. A torch
   C. Stars
   D. A candle

11. Which grouping of gases is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Stone, water and wood are liquids
   B. Milk, chalk and steam are solids
   C. Sugar, oil and air are solids
   D. Air, steam and cooking gas are gases

12. Which of these is a good way to care for a farm animal? (1 mark)
   A. Beat it
   B. Give clean water and shelter
   C. Give it dirty water
   D. Leave it in the rain

13. What can you use to draw and label a plant if you have a computer at school? (1 mark)
   A. A calculator only
   B. A ruler only
   C. A stopwatch
   D. A drawing app

14. Which of these can make a river dry up? (1 mark)
   A. Using rain tanks
   B. Saving water
   C. Planting trees
   D. Cutting trees near it and wasting water

15. Why should pupils not touch hot sufurias? (1 mark)
   A. They become cold
   B. They become bigger
   C. They make sound
   D. They can burn their skin

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe two properties of a liquid. (3 marks)

17. List the five groups of vertebrates and give one example of each. (3 marks)

18. Explain why rubbing your hands makes them warm. (2 marks)

19. Classify these as natural or artificial: candle, stars, torch, lightning, firefly, solar lamp. (4 marks)

20. Explain how light helps in security and safety. Give three examples. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Butterfly
   A butterfly has six legs and three body parts.

2. D — Something that gives out its own light
   A source of light makes its own light.

3. B — Drinking clean water and ORS as advised
   Water and ORS replace what the body loses.

4. B — Oil its moving joints
   Oil reduces friction.

5. B — To grip the road
   Grip needs friction.

6. B — Gravity
   Gravity pulls the ball to the ground.

7. D — The sun
   Sun heat dries fish.

8. B — Growing taller over time
   Plants grow, reproduce, remove waste, respond and die. They do not walk or make noise.

9. B — A liquid in the mouth that wets food
   Saliva wets food and starts to digest starchy foods.

10. C — Stars
   Stars give out their own light.

11. D — Air, steam and cooking gas are gases
   Air, steam and cooking gas are gases.

12. B — Give clean water and shelter
   Farm animals need water, food, shelter and care.

13. D — A drawing app
   A drawing app can be used to draw and label plant parts.

14. D — Cutting trees near it and wasting water
   Cutting trees near sources reduces water.

15. D — They can burn their skin
   Hot metal burns.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: A liquid has a fixed volume and no shape of its own. It takes the shape of its container and can be poured.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of two properties and 1 mark for the example.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mammals (goat), birds (hen), reptiles (snake), amphibians (frog), fish (tilapia).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for correct five groups, 1 mark for four examples, 1 mark for correct matching.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Rubbing causes friction and friction produces heat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for friction and 1 mark for heat.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Natural: stars, lightning, firefly. Artificial: candle, torch, solar lamp.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair, plus 1 mark for correct table.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Street lights help people see, security lights keep thieves away, traffic lights direct drivers, torches show dangers, reflectors.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.
